title: Wind & Water Power Projects
intro: The flagship unit: anemometers, a working windmill water pump, stream turbines and the physics of harvesting Kenya's wind and water.

lessons.title: Wind Is Moving Air: Where It Comes From
lessons.focus: Sun heats land unevenly → convection → wind; Kenyan winds: Lake Turkana jet, Ngong hills, coastal monsoons.
lessons.advanced: Explain the sea-breeze cycle at the coast with land/water heating rates; when does it reverse?

lessons.title: Build: A Wind Sock and the Beaufort Scale
lessons.focus: Sew/tape a sock from a plastic bag on a pole; read direction and estimate strength with a picture scale.
lessons.advanced: Keep a week log of direction/strength; compute the prevailing direction and justify with a simple vector tally.

lessons.title: Build: A Cup Anemometer
lessons.focus: Bottle-top cups on crossed sticks around a pencil axle; count turns in 30 s against a reference chart (or phone slow-motion).
lessons.advanced: Calibrate: passenger counts turns at known vehicle speeds (safe, from inside!); produce a turns→km/h card.

lessons.title: Wind Force on Surfaces
lessons.focus: Feel push on card at angles; sail and blade angle intro; force grows with area and with speed squared.
lessons.advanced: Use F≈½ρAv² to estimate force on a 1 m² signboard at 15 m/s; why do billboards fail in storms?

lessons.title: Windmills of East Africa: Kijito and Kamkwamba
lessons.focus: Kijito wind pumps of Kenya and William Kamkwamba's Malawi windmill; mechanical water pumping heritage; what makes a good site.
lessons.advanced: Compare a wind pump vs solar pump for a borehole: energy source pattern vs water demand pattern.

lessons.title: How a Wind Pump Works: Rotor to Piston
lessons.focus: Blades catch wind → crank/cam turns rotation into up-down → pump rod lifts water; trace the energy chain.
lessons.advanced: Crank radius 5 cm, pump bore 3 cm: relate rotor torque to lift force per stroke.

lessons.title: Blade Physics: Angle, Lift and Drag
lessons.focus: Test flat vs curved vs angled blades in fan wind; measure spin speed; the modern curved blade wins.
lessons.advanced: Explain lift on a curved blade with Bernoulli-style reasoning; why does too-steep pitch stall?

lessons.title: Build: The Paper Pinwheel
lessons.focus: First rotor: pin and pencil pinwheel; test blade counts 2/4/6; free spin vs loaded (lifting a thread).
lessons.advanced: Why does a 3-blade rotor often beat 6 for speed but lose on starting torque? Test and discuss.

lessons.title: Windmill Project I: Rotor and Hub
lessons.focus: Build the working rotor: blades from mabati offcuts or stiff plastic on a bicycle hub/nail bearing; balance it.
lessons.advanced: Balance the rotor dynamically: explain wobble sources and fix via counterweights.

lessons.title: Windmill Project II: Tower and Yaw
lessons.focus: Triangulated tower (Unit 13!), tail vane keeps rotor facing wind; safe height for school (2–3 m).
lessons.advanced: Compute the overturning moment at full wind on the rotor disc; specify pegging to resist it.

lessons.title: Windmill Project III: The Drive Train
lessons.focus: Crank or cam converts rotation to reciprocation; connecting rod to the pump; friction points oiled.
lessons.advanced: Measure stroke length vs crank radius; relate strokes/minute to rotor rpm and gear options.

lessons.title: Windmill Project IV: Linking the Pump
lessons.focus: Connect the Unit 8 diaphragm pump; suction line to a water container; check valve orientation verified.
lessons.advanced: Predict litres/minute from rotor rpm × stroke volume at your measured efficiency.

lessons.title: Windmill Project V: Test Day
lessons.focus: Run in wind: measure water lifted per minute at 1 m head; photograph, log, celebrate; safety perimeter for spinning blades.
lessons.advanced: Compute hydraulic power out (ρgQh) vs estimated wind power in (½ρAv³); the honest efficiency.

lessons.title: Windmill Project VI: Iteration
lessons.focus: One improvement each team: blade pitch, tail size, bearing friction, stroke length; A/B test against the log.
lessons.advanced: Design the A/B test so wind variation doesn't fool you (interleave trials); report with error bars.

lessons.title: Windmill Project VII: Data and Graphs
lessons.focus: Compile output vs wind speed; find the cut-in speed; present the performance curve.
lessons.advanced: Fit output ∝ (v − v_cutin) approximately; justify the cubic-energy intuition behind the curve's shape.

lessons.title: Windmill Project VIII: Engineering Report
lessons.focus: Teams present: design, data, failures, fixes, costs; audience of teachers and a jua kali guest if possible.
lessons.advanced: Include a costing: materials, hours, water per day — compare with a jerrican-carried alternative.

lessons.title: Water Power: Head and Flow
lessons.focus: Energy = mgh of falling water; micro-hydro reality in Kenya's highlands; head vs flow trade for power.
lessons.advanced: Stream: 2 L/s falling 5 m: compute available power; what could it run?

lessons.title: Water Wheels: Undershot and Overshot
lessons.focus: History of mills; undershot uses stream speed, overshot uses weight; efficiency intuition; model both.
lessons.advanced: Explain why overshot beats undershot on the same water: which energy form each harvests.

lessons.title: Build: The Spoon Wheel Turbine I
lessons.focus: Spoons/bottle scoops on a bottle wheel; mount on wire axle; rig a string-and-bobbin to lift weights.
lessons.advanced: Predict lift rate from cup fill volume × rpm; identify the two main losses.

lessons.title: Build: The Spoon Wheel Turbine II — Test Under the Tap
lessons.focus: Run under tap/stream; measure rpm vs flow and max weight lifted; graph; compare teams.
lessons.advanced: Compute mechanical power from lift rate; compare with water power in; where's the loss?

lessons.title: From Motion to Electricity: The Dynamo Teaser
lessons.focus: Bicycle dynamo demo: spin → bulb lights; generator is a motor backwards; bridge to CBE 3.2 next year.
lessons.advanced: Estimate: your turbine spins a dynamo at 5 V/0.3 A — efficiency chain from stream to light.

lessons.title: The Ram and the Siphon Return
lessons.focus: Review: both move water with no engine; ram needs fall, siphon needs outlet lower than inlet; pick per site.
lessons.advanced: Site: spring 3 m above field, 100 m away, stream crossing between: siphon, ram or pipe? Defend with head math.

lessons.title: Rainwater Harvesting Physics
lessons.focus: Roof catchment = rainfall × area; gutters and first-flush; tank sizing for the dry term; Kenyan rainfall patterns.
lessons.advanced: Roof 60 m², rain 800 mm/year, dry spell 90 days at 200 L/day: size the tank in m³ with reasoning.

lessons.title: Gravity Water Schemes: From Spring to Village
lessons.focus: Survey head with the Unit 7 water level; pipe sizing to limit friction; break-pressure tanks on long drops.
lessons.advanced: A 3 km pipe drops 120 m: why insert break-pressure tanks? Compute static pressure at the bottom without them.

lessons.title: Storing Energy: Two Tanks and a Pump
lessons.focus: Pumped storage idea: pump up when sunny/windy, flow down when needed; compare with batteries and flywheels.
lessons.advanced: 1000 L raised 5 m stores how many kJ? What bulb wattage for how long at 50% round-trip efficiency?

lessons.title: Community Wind & Water Survey
lessons.focus: Walk the area: note streams, slopes, windy ridges, existing pumps; interview a fundi; map resources.
lessons.advanced: Score three sites with a weighted matrix (head, flow, distance, demand); defend the weights.

lessons.title: Design Brief: Power for Our School
lessons.focus: Teams design one wind or water solution for a real school need (garden watering, handwash station); drawings and budget.
lessons.advanced: Include energy budget: demand L/day, source power curve, storage, and the worst-month shortfall plan.

lessons.title: Unit Review: Energy Projects Showcase
lessons.focus: Windmill, turbines and surveys on show; visitors try the anemometer; unit quiz.
lessons.advanced: Panel question: 'Is small wind worth it here?' — argue from your measured data, both sides.
